name: Svojo mesto
source:
For centuries, two peoples have lived side by side.
They long for peace, yet are doomed to conflict whether by the will of the gods or by nature itself. Every peace declared proves to be nothing more than a temporary truce, and woe to those who find themselves among strangers when it ends. Out of place. Unwelcome.

Young Ove, a tanner’s apprentice, has never known life beyond his northern homeland. But in a time of war, he must rise to defend a friend who has been cast out of their village into the vast, unforgiving forest — a death sentence in all but name.
translation:
几个世纪以来，两个民族一直毗邻共存。
他们渴望和平，但无论是出于众神的意志还是出于自然本身，都注定要发生冲突。每一次宣布的和平都被证明只不过是暂时的休战，对于那些在和平结束时发现自己身处陌生人之中的人来说是灾难。不合适。不受欢迎。

年轻的欧维是一位制革商的学徒，他从未了解过北方家乡以外的生活。但在战争时期，他必须挺身而出，保护一位被赶出村庄、进入广阔无情森林的朋友——这实际上等于宣判了死刑。
